name: NVL-512 GPU - A0

fB93xx.name: PreviousSocketBinning
fB93xx.description: Previous socket binning (Dice skipped during SDT Good die only testing; e.g., previously bad bin at CMT or SDS)

fB93xx.name: MinDieSkipTray
fB93xx.description: Deprecated / no longer used (No longer used)

fB93xx.name: OverTouched
fB93xx.description: Touchdown count exceeded limit (Die skipped because it exceeded ThermalAction touchdown limit)

fB93xx.name: Incomplete
fB93xx.description: Incomplete die data in ituff (Tester crash or Podituff issue; iLLIAD limit should be 1)

fB93xx.name: VisionTrayReject
fB93xx.description: Incoming No-Go tray reject (Vision rejected entire tray on first sort; resort keeps previous bin data)

fB93xx.name: VisionUnitReject
fB93xx.description: BVIU No-Go unit reject (Vision rejected die prior to test; may map to 9305 depending on flow)

fB93xx.name: VisionUnitSkip
fB93xx.description: IOM unit-level skip (Vision rejected unit during IOM inspection)

fB93xx.name: UnitAlign
fB93xx.description: Unit alignment skip (Manual skip due to alignment alarm)

fB93xx.name: UnitAlignZ
fB93xx.description: Unit alignment Z difference skip (Manual skip due to Z difference alarm 600147/600152)

fB93xx.name: UnitAlignFail
fB93xx.description: Unit alignment auto-skip (Auto skip due to alignment alarm)

fB93xx.name: UnitAlignZFail
fB93xx.description: Unit alignment Z difference auto-skip (Auto skip due to Z difference alarm 600147/600152)

fB93xx.name: PnpPutTH
fB93xx.description: Pick-and-place put at test head skip (Triggered by vacuum/place alarms 660104, 660107, etc.)

fB93xx.name: PnpTray
fB93xx.description: Pick-and-place tray pickup skip (Triggered by tray pick alarms 660100, 660110)

fB93xx.name: AlcComm
fB93xx.description: Vision communication failure (Image transfer error alarm 040012)

fB93xx.name: CoarseAlign
fB93xx.description: Coarse alignment skip (BVIU coarse alignment alarm 660400)

fB93xx.name: DeviceAlign
fB93xx.description: Device alignment skip (Alignment alarm 600118)

fB93xx.name: HCTriggeredSkip
fB93xx.description: Handler controller triggered skip (Generic skip not covered by other handler events)

fB93xx.name: TrayMapOverride
fB93xx.description: Tray map override skip (Override determines tested die; behavior depends on E/G and inking state)

fB93xx.name: DiePocketEmpty
fB93xx.description: Empty die pocket (Presence bin E; verified via SOD or WTT map)

fB93xx.name: BadDie
fB93xx.description: Bad die (Presence bin B; only one latest presence value per die)

fB93xx.name: FlaggedForSkip
fB93xx.description: Inked or overlay skip (IB200/IB190; overrides presence bin; visible in Blazar SDX_DONTTESTINK)

fB93xx.name: Scrapped
fB93xx.description: Scrapped wafer or die (Partial wafer scrapped; may retain prior test bins)

fB93xx.name: Unknown
fB93xx.description: Unknown condition (Examples include tray on hold or missing DPC start; iLLIAD limit should be 1)

_comment_sicccydyn-info:
SICC/UPM/CDYN testlist config — column rename patterns and sum definitions.
  Targets (sicc_targets, upm_targets, cdyn_targets) come from the Product Config JSON, not here.
_comment_upmInfo: 1st column =  Display name  2nd column - test name,3rd name is target
_comment_siccList: 1st column =  Display name  2nd column - test name 3rd column - target
_comment_siccTotalList: 1st column =  Display name , rest things to add, last column is target
_comment_cdynList: cdynList: [wildcard_pattern, friendly_display_name, target] — one entry per individual test, matches raw CSV column names (case-insensitive ordered tokens)
_comment_testprogram_folder: Default TestProgram folder for this product — auto-loaded into the pipeline from Product Config (not shown in GUI).
